question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a blue present, Bob has a purple present, Claire has a gold present, Dave has a yellow present, Eve has a silver present, Fred has a grey present, and Gertrude has a green present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Dave has the
Options:
(A) blue present
(B) purple present
(C) gold present
(D) yellow present
(E) silver present
(F) grey present
(G) green present
solution:
Present colors are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: blue, purple, gold, yellow, silver, grey, green
1. Gertrude and Fred swap: blue, purple, gold, yellow, silver, green, grey
2. Claire and Eve swap: blue, purple, silver, yellow, gold, green, grey
3. Eve and Gertrude swap: blue, purple, silver, yellow, grey, green, gold
4. Dave and Bob swap: blue, yellow, silver, purple, grey, green, gold
5. Claire and Gertrude swap: blue, yellow, gold, purple, grey, green, silver
6. Eve and Bob swap: blue, grey, gold, purple, yellow, green, silver
7. Gertrude and Fred swap: blue, grey, gold, purple, yellow, silver, green
Dave has the purple present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
